ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and UBOs against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council sanctions list, European Union consolidated sanctions list, and Colombia’s national terrorism and money-laundering lists. PEP status must be identified under Law 2010/2019 and UIAF Circular 009 of 2016. Enhanced due diligence is triggered for PEPs, non-resident shareholders, or any link to high-risk jurisdictions.}},

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (operated by the Cámara de Comercio of the registered address, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish or in a form previously adapted to Spanish phonetic and grammatical usage. Foreign-language terms may be transliterated into the Latin script using Spanish character conventions; no diacritical restrictions apply.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Sociedad de Beneficio e Interés Colectivo

stage_1.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The name reservation may be extended for a single additional 30-day term by filing an extension request before the initial period expires. If the registry rejects a proposed name, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición (reconsideration appeal) with the same Cámara de Comercio within ten (10) business days of notification; if the rejection is affirmed, the applicant may then file a horizontal recurso de apelación with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within ten (10) business days after the resolution of the reposición. The SIC’s decision is final on the administrative level.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are technically permissible for correspondence, but the S.A.S. must provide a physical address within Colombia for the registered office and for receiving official judicial and regulatory notices. For a government-affairs and lobbying advisory enterprise, regulators may require an active operational office in Bogotá; a purely virtual address without a physical reception desk or substantive local staff creates heightened substance risk.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium – statistical probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 24 months is estimated at 35%, higher than the general corporate average (12%) due to the political-sensitivity of the lobbying activity and the enhanced AML classification (Medium_Risk_Enhanced).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (the Simplified Stock Corporation Act, S.A.S.), arts. 1, 3, 5, 10, 17-18; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), arts. 98, 110, 353, 373-435; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (Unique Regulatory Decree of Commerce) arts. 2.2.2.1.1 et seq. (RUES registration); Ley 2013 de 2019 (Public Interest Management / lobbying registration); Resolución DIAN No. 000165 de 2023 (electronic invoicing).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) / Ventanilla Única Empresarial
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument bearing notarially authenticated shareholder signatures), registered in the Mercantile Registry of the Chamber of Commerce
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital: an S.A.S. may be formed with zero or nominal capital (e.g., COP 1,000 ≈ USD 0.24). Under Ley 1258/2008, art. 3, the subscribed capital must be fully paid within two (2) years from incorporation; no escrow or blocked-account requirement applies. Inbound contributions from foreign shareholders must additionally be reported to Banco de la República via the summary foreign-exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio, Form No. 3).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — Colombia S.A.S. (ISIC 7020). The undersigned founding shareholders, having accepted the capital subscription schedule set out in the articles of incorporation, unanimously RESOLVE: (1) the subscribed shares, their nominal value, and payment terms are approved and recorded; (2) the registered office and legal domicile are adopted as stated in the corporate bylaws; (3) [full name and ID] is appointed Legal Representative with broad powers to execute the corporate purpose, open bank accounts, and represent the company before public authorities; (4) the appointed accountant is ratified; (5) the Legal Representative is authorized to lodge the incorporation with the Chamber of Commerce, complete DIAN procedures, report ultimate beneficial owners, and register the company in the Public Interest-Manager Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-validation and Reservation of Corporate Name (Homologación de Nombre)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co) or in-person window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Compose the filing electronically on the RUES portal or at the Ventanilla Única Empresarial window; pay the nominal search fee; obtain the certificado de homologación de nombre confirming that no identical or confusingly similar denomination is already registered. The name reservation is valid for thirty (30) calendar days.
required_dossiers: Formulario de homologación de nombre (RUES pre-reservation form)
Identification of each founding shareholder (cédula de ciudadanía or valid passport)
At least three proposed corporate names in order of preference
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for similarity or conflicting trademark, resubmit alternative denominations; the administrative refusal may be cured promptly within the 30-day reservation window. A formal recurso de reposición may be filed before the Chamber of Commerce, with subsidiary appeal to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Private Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública chosen by the founding shareholders (any notary in the registered-domicile jurisdiction)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish, including the mandatory S.A.S. clauses: corporate name, domicile (city-level), lawful corporate purpose referencing ISIC 7020 (management consultancy and government-relations advisory), term, capital subscription and deferred-payment table, board structure, legal-representative powers, accounting period, and dissolution rules. All founding shareholders sign before a notary to authenticate their signatures (autenticación notarial); if real property is contributed, the document must be elevated to an escritura pública and registered with the Registro de Instrumentos Públicos.
required_dossiers: Valid original identification of every shareholder or legalized powers of attorney
Certificado de homologación de nombre (name pre-validation certificate)
Draft Documento Privado de Constitución / estatutos embodying the ISIC 7020 corporate purpose
Certified translations and apostille for foreign corporate shareholders
Foreign-exchange declaration draft (when foreign capital is contributed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A notarial rejection based on signature or identification defects is cured by presenting corrected credentials or by executing a new authenticated signature page; material omissions are fixed through an 'otro sí' (amendment) executed with the same formalities before filing, with no penalty if the Registry has not yet processed the certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration at the Chamber of Commerce and Issuance of Provisional NIT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the executed instrument at the Chamber of Commerce desk or upload it on the RUES platform using a certified electronic signature. The Chamber verifies statutory content, books the company in the Mercantile Registry, issues the certificado de existencia y representación legal, and automatically assigns the provisional NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). The registrar also opens the corporate books (libro de actas and libro de registro de acciones) at a tariffed fee.
required_dossiers: Authenticated Documento Privado de Constitución (or notarial public deed)
Fully completed Mercantile Registry application form (Formulario Único de Matrícula Mercantil)
Proof of payment of registration fees (recibo oficial de tesorería)
Pre-validated name certificate
Beneficial-owner questionnaire data for the eventual RUB file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a defect notice (requerimiento), the applicant has ten (10) business days to correct and resubmit; failure leads to filing expiration and loss of fees. A rejection order is appealable by recurso de reposición before the same Chamber within five (5) days, and in apelación before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within five (5) days thereafter (Código de Procedimiento Administrativo, arts. 74-76).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: DIAN Taxpayer Registration (RUT) and Electronic Invoicing Authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Registro Único Tributario module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the provisional NIT, access the DIAN electronic portal (www.dian.gov.co) and finalize the RUT selecting CIIU code 7020 (Management Consultancy activities) and the relevant tax regime: corporate income tax under the general system, the 0% VAT export regime for cross-border advisory services rendered to foreign stakeholders, and payroll withholding registration once employees are hired. Request authorization for electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) under Resolución DIAN No. 000165 de 2023 and obtain the digital-signature certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificado de existencia y representación legal (with provisional NIT)
RUT registration form (Formulario No. 0020)
Registered-office lease or ownership title and a public-services invoice as proof of address
Legal representative's identification document
If applicable, foreign tax-residence declarations for the shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN issues a requirement regarding domicile, shareholders, or activity codes, the taxpayer answers within ten (10) business days with documentary proof; an unfavourable RUT classification is appealable through the recurso de reconsideración to the regional DIAN office, after which judicial review remains available.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Compliance: Corporate Books, Beneficial Owners, Employer Enrollment, and Interest-Manager Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá; DIAN — Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB); Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL); Secretaría de Transparencia, Presidencia de la República
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within fifteen (15) business days of mercantile registration, file the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) with DIAN; stamp and register the corporate books at the Chamber of Commerce; before contracting employees, register the company as an employer with an ARL, EPS, and Caja de Compensación via the PILA/AFI channels. Concurrently, file for the company's and the legal representative's enrolment in the Registro Público de Gestores de Intereses maintained by the Secretaría de Transparencia, including proposed engagements and conflict-of-interest statements (Ley 2013 de 2019).
required_dossiers: Updated Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Final RUT / NIT certificate
RUB online declaration reporting the ultimate beneficial owners
Employer registration forms (PILA / AFI) and ARL contract (if hiring personnel)
Interest-management registration application and conflict-of-interest form for the acting 'gestor de intereses'
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A RUB filing made after the deadline attracts a fine of up to 300 UVT; voluntary submission with corrective payment reduces exposure. Refusal to enrol as a 'gestor de intereses' is remedied by completing the missing disclosures and filing a due-submission application before undertaking any lobbying activity. ARL irregularity is cured by signing the risk-class contract retroactively to the payroll start date and paying overdue contributions without surcharge if done before a formal labour inspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Secretaría de Transparencia, Presidencia de la República — Dirección de Gestión de Intereses (public-interest lobbying registry); Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for personal-data processing authorization under Ley 1581 de 2012
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Público de Gestores de Intereses (Individual and Corporate Interest-Manager Registration) under Ley 2013 de 2019; complementary SIC Data-Processing Registration (Registro Nacional de Bases de Datos) authorization

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the applicable municipal environmental authority (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente — Bogotá / Corporación Autónoma Regional — CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 'No EIA Required': administrative consultancy (ISIC 7020) with an office-based asset footprint is not listed in the licensing catalogue of Decreto 1076 de 2015, Libro 2, Título 2; no full environmental impact assessment or environmental registration certificate is required for this non-manufacturing use.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial point-source discharge; the operation must comply with municipal sewer ordinances for sanitary wastewater and with Decreto 1076 de 2015, Título 3. Solid wastes must be separated using the colour code of Resolución 2184 de 2019, and the single-use plastics ban of Ley 2232 de 2022 applies to procurement. Office operations presumptively produce nil VOC/PM emissions; therefore no stationary-source air permit under Resolución 909 de 2008 is required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Municipal Fire Safety Certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) verifying evacuation capacity, extinguisher placement, and electrical load; occupancy and structural-safety endorsement from the building manager or Curaduría Urbana (certificado de seguridad estructural) for the leased offices; mandatory workplace-conditions compliance under the S.G.S.S.T. regime — ARL risk classification (clases I-II), first-aid equipment, and accident-reporting procedures; optional exterior-signage permit if the office displays public-facing corporate identification (publicidad exterior visual, Ley 140 de 1994).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – central tax and customs administration; electronic portal DIAN MUISCA and Cámara de Comercio registration integration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned S.A.S. must be incorporated before a notary and registered with the competent Cámara de Comercio; simultaneously request NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) from DIAN through MUISCA using the corporate registration certificate, valid bylaws, proof of address, appointment of legal representative with standing power, and foreign shareholder identification. Foreign investors need an appointed agent in Colombia and must obtain RUT (Registro Único Tributario) plus NIT before commencing taxable operations or hiring locally.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: The S.A.S. is a separate juridical and tax-paying person subject to Colombian corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta) and complementary taxes on worldwide income for tax resident entities; non-resident shareholders are taxed only on Colombian-source income and dividends at source, with no check-the-box pass-through available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no US-style check-the-box election. Statutory elections affecting entity tax classification include: (i) no automatic conversion absent reorganization; (ii) optional simplified taxation regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación) for eligible corporations with qualifying gross income, replacing income, VAT and municipal industry-commerce taxes in some respects, subject to size thresholds and shareholder composition; and (iii) conventional anti-hybrid and CFC rules under which Colombian law disregards hybrid instruments without elective conformity.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas) plus complementary national consumption tax and municipal industry and commerce tax (ICA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for VAT-responsible status: any person performing taxable sales, rendering taxable services within Colombia, importing taxable goods, or agreeing to supply taxable services from abroad is required to register as a VAT responsible party from its first taxable event. Simplified business regime thresholds (e.g., up to 3,500 UVT) are only for natural persons or certain simple taxpayers and do not apply to the S.A.S. corporate entity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta) for all VAT-responsible taxpayers, including the S.A.S.; invoices must be generated and transmitted in real time to authorized DIAN clearing technology operators through the DIAN MUISCA web-service APIs, must contain UUID plus DIAN validation code and QR Code (Código Único de Facturación), and must be accepted/rejected by the recipient before issuance is complete; non-compliant invoices invalidate input VAT credits.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT/IVA rate applies to export of goods (sale and physical removal from Colombian customs territory) and export of services (offshore services rendered to foreign residents that are used exclusively abroad and paid by non-residents). The responsible exporter may take Credits for underlying input VAT and request refund (devolución), subject to actual repatriation of foreign currency and DIAN validation of the service's extraterritorial use. Lobbying and government-affairs related services to foreign clients may qualify only if the benefit is localized abroad and the client is a foreign entity.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) registered in the VUCE/SIGLO system and accepted by DIAN customs control
Bill of Lading (BL) or Air Waybill evidencing physical exit of goods from Colombia
Commercial Invoice for Export aligned with e-invoicing requirements
Certificate of Inspection/Packing List where applicable
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro Económico) from a Colombian authorized FX intermediary evidencing collection within the mandated deadline
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit documentary and economic substance, reject refund, and retroactively claw back VAT credits with daily interest (sanción por inexactitud up to 200% of the omitted or improperly determined amount under Articles 648 and 671 of the Tax Statute), impose a fine of up to 100% of the improperly recovered VAT in cases of falsified customs documents, and criminally prosecute invoice and customs fraud, plus denial of subsequent export refunds for up to 2 years following unsuccessful fraudulent claims.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (the Central Bank), jointly with the Financial Superintendence of Colombia (Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia) and the National Directorate of Taxes and Customs (DIAN), under the foreign-exchange regime (Régimen Cambiario) established by Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1068 of 2015 and the External Communications of the Central Bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed-floating exchange-rate system with a market-clearing COP/USD rate and full convertibility for current-account transactions, including service exports and outward profit remittances that are channeled through authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries. Capital-account transactions are liberalized but subject to mandatory declaration, channeling and registration with Banco de la República's International Investment Registry: foreign direct investment (FDI) into a Colombian S.A.S. must be registered to create the legal entitlement to future dividend and capital repatriation. Profit remittance is not quantitatively limited or sequenced, yet the effective tax claw-back consists of a 10% dividend withholding tax for non-resident shareholders and a 7.5% remittance tax for other payments to foreign beneficiaries; the principal practical hurdles are the need to present the FDI registration certificate at the time of each remittance and to file and retain the corresponding exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio / Form DC-1) for every operation above the regulatory threshold. Convertibility obstacles arise mainly from delays in obtaining the investment-registration certificate, mismatched corporate-purpose codes in wiring instructions, and documentary gaps in proving the underlying commercial reality of lobbying services.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters of services (including ISIC 7020 government-affairs advisory and cross-border lobbying consulting) are subject to mandatory canalización: 100% of foreign-currency proceeds must be channeled through the Colombian foreign-exchange market, either by crediting a domestic foreign-currency account at an authorized intermediary or by selling the currency to the intermediary, within 6 months from the date services are completed or the receivable falls due, as established by Banco de la República External Communications. Colombia does not impose statutory conversion into COP; proceeds may be retained in USD domestically or in a registered foreign compensation account (cuenta de compensación). Each collection must be evidenced by a certificate of channeling (comprobante de canalización) and the associated Form DC-1, and the entire compliance file (export document, invoice, SWIFT credit advice, channeling certificate) must be retained for at least five years.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.services_export_declaration_obligations: For service receivables exceeding the de minimis threshold, the S.A.S. must ensure the intermediary records the service classification code from the Manual de Clasificación Cambiaria (e.g., the business and management-consulting services code) on the Form DC-1; erroneous classification as an import or as a non-registered capital flow triggers channeling nullity, recharacterization risk and fines under the foreign-exchange regime. The service export contract, deliverable evidence and the client's acceptance must substantiate every receivable because the DIAN and the Central Bank cross-match declaration codes against corporate revenue classification in the tax files.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational COP current account plus USD-denominated sub-account (cuenta en moneda extranjera) for channeled export proceeds
Operational COP current account with integrated online FX desk
Operational COP current account and capital-escrow route for inbound FDI (cuenta de capital)
Operational COP current account with digital treasury platform
Multi-currency settlement account (COP/USD/EUR) with trade-finance desk
Operational COP current account with cross-border parent-bank alignment

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: LOW as a primary treasury rail. Colombian law reserves deposit-taking and current-account banking activity to institutions licensed by the Financial Superintendence of Colombia; an offshore fintech EMI cannot legally provide a COP-denominated operating account to the S.A.S. resident entity, cannot issue compliant comprobantes de canalización, and cannot support the FDI registration obligation. An offshore digital bank may be used solely as an auxiliary multi-currency account for disbursements to foreign subcontractors outside the Colombian system, provided no Colombian export-service collection is received there and no payment is made from it for local costs. Any attempt to collect Colombian exports through an unregistered foreign account without a compensation-account authorization breaches the foreign-exchange regime and is not acceptable.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one legal representative, normally a Colombian-resident director holding a valid cédula or NIT, must appear physically at the branch for the initial onboarding interview, signature of the account mandate and biometric verification; foreign non-resident directors may participate through a notarized power of attorney legalized with an Apostille, supported by a live video-identity call where bank policy allows. A fully remote opening or a remote-only video KYC without any in-person appearance is not generally attainable for an offshore-owned S.A.S. on a full treasury line; the bank will commonly perform an address-verification visit at the registered office and may request the statutory lobbying license or the Chamber of Commerce certificate reflecting the ISIC 7020 / CIIU code before activating foreign-currency and credit facilities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore corporate-ownership chain with one or more non-resident ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) obscuring the true source of capital
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UIAF-compliant declaration of ultimate beneficial owner with ownership percentages, identity documents of each UBO, apostilled shareholding-structure chart, notarized shareholders' register, and bank reference letters from the UBOs' home financial institutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Government-affairs and lobbying activity flagged as elevated corruption/PEP risk, especially when clients belong to public-sector stakeholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory license/registration under the Colombian lobbying rules, detailed retainer contracts with scope-of-work limitations, PEP and sanctions screening results of clients and UBOs, internal conflicts-of-interest and gifts/hospitality policy, and professional-indemnity insurance certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Retainer-wire business model combined with payments to foreign subcontractors creating indirect layering or round-tripping exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Service-export file for every receivable: signed engagement letter, deliverable reports, client acceptance e-mails, and subcontractor proforma invoices, jointly demonstrating that all counterparty flows carry genuine economic purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient economic substance at the registered address (S.A.S. virtual office at a service provider)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tenancy lease agreement for the Colombian office, payroll or outsourced-staff documentation, DIAN tax-address confirmation, corporate website and e-mail on a Colombian domain, local telephone line, and a corporate organizational chart showing a resident operational team.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk inbound transfer for initial equity injection arriving from a FATF grey-listed or non-cooperative jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investor KYC file with audited financial statements, source-of-wealth memorandum, shareholder resolution approving the investment, sworn statement of absence of money-laundering or terrorism-financing exposure, and the FDI registration request presented simultaneously to the bank's foreign-exchange desk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Misalignment between the declared corporate purpose (government-relations advisory) and the bank's internal list of prohibited or condoned sectors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Chamber of Commerce certificate with the exact CIIU 7020 code, the statutory lobbying license, a business-plan narrative explaining the advisory nature, clear separation of advocacy from transactional influence, and recent audited or unaudited accounts proving lawful fee income.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: External equity contributions into the S.A.S. must be received via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own bank account into the Colombian intermediary's nostro or the recipient's foreign-currency account, with the sender identified as the registered investor and field 70 referencing the purpose 'Inversión directa de capital - aporte al capital social' and, where practical, the investor's tax-identification number. On credit, the local bank performs the channeling, issues the comprobante de canalización, and files the declaración de cambio with the classification code for direct-investment equity contributions (e.g., code 2110); the company must then obtain the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales certificate from Banco de la República within the applicable statutory window, best practice being five business days. Maximum integrity is achieved by wiring exclusively from the UBO's own account, avoiding third-party interposed funding, and formalizing the shareholder-resolution and share-issuance documents in Colombia before the transfer is cleared. Any inbound receipt not matched to the filing of exchange forms or the FDI registration creates a risk of nullity, fines, and the loss of future remittance rights.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For disbursements to foreign sub-consultants, suppliers and advisors, the treasury must use SWIFT MT103 messages with a clear purpose description and invoice reference, executed by the local bank after a parallel purchase of US dollars or euros through the foreign-exchange channel; the corresponding Form DC-1 declaring the service payment must be filed and retained. For substantial procurement, commercial letters of credit (advised or confirmed via SWIFT MT700) and standby guarantees provide the appropriate instrument. Domestic creditors entering the Colombian system are paid through ACH Colombia or the bank's online platform in COP. All foreign-currency payments must be supported by an economic-substantiation document (contract, invoice, delivery note or acceptance record) to sustain both FX-compliance and tax-deductibility in a DIAN audit. The treasury file should maintain a clean reconciliation trail from invoice to SWIFT credit, with the exchange-settlement ticket and the channeling certificate for every operation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla COP/USD forward contracts entered into with authorized local financial intermediaries to hedge committed outflows and projected retainer inflows
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing the Colombian peso, executed by local banks through offshore mirror transactions for hedging the S.A.S.'s net open foreign-currency position
Cross-currency swaps (COP/USD) matching the inward FDI equity injection against future dividend-remittance and repatriation obligations
Zero-cost collars and plain-vanilla FX option strategies with licensed banks, admitted exclusively where a genuine underlying commercial exposure exists and speculative positioning is prohibited
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.local_liquidity_management: The S.A.S. treasury should maintain a COP operating account as the primary liquidity hub, a USD sub-account strictly for channeled export proceeds, and separate escrow-style tracking for inbound FDI before registration; daily positions must be reconciled to the Comprobante de Canalización ledger to avoid unregistered foreign-currency holdings above the de minimis threshold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.regulatory_change_monitoring: The treasury blueprint is subject to Banco de la República External Communications, DIAN rulings, and the Financial Superintendence AML circulars (notably UIAF Circular 009); the compliance calendar must include quarterly monitoring of changes to service-export channeling deadlines, FDI registration deadlines, and reserve requirements that may be re-imposed during balance-of-payments stress.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación Anual de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual renewal of commercial registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá); oversight by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March; no anniversary-based extension for S.A.S. entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs a mora surcharge plus Chamber-imposed administrative fines; persistent non-renewal for consecutive annual cycles can lead to cancellation of the commercial registration and administrative strike-off of the company from the Registro Mercantil.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Renta y Complementarios (annual corporate income tax return), Form 110
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For the calendar tax year, due between the 8th business day of August and the 12th business day of September of the following year, per DIAN annual resolution according to the last two NIT digits
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of tax due per month or fraction thereof, capped at 100% of the tax, plus default interest; continued failure permits DIAN assessment (liquidación de aforo), coercive collection, and freezing of bank accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Aprobación y depósito de los Estados Financieros de Propósito General (approval and public registry deposit of annual financial statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Asamblea de Accionistas; thereafter Cámara de Comercio (commercial registry) and, when required, DIAN
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting to approve year-end financial statements no later than 31 March of the following year; deposit with the Chamber of Commerce concurrently with the annual commercial renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-deposit may block the annual renewal, trigger Chamber-imposed fines, expose directors and officers to civil and statutory liability, and after repeated non-compliance contribute to cancellation of the registration and strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena y Anexo de Precios de Transferencia (annual exogenous information return and transfer pricing annex, if thresholds are met)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due per DIAN annual resolution, generally during the second quarter of the year following the reporting tax year, based on the taxpayer's NIT digit schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Article 651 of the Colombian Tax Code for late, inaccurate, or omitted information (up to UVT-denominated caps per data item), plus default interest and risk of forced tax assessment; does not by itself trigger strike-off but may impair corporate standing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An S.A.S. must appoint a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) if in the prior year total assets exceed approximately 5,000 monthly minimum wages (SMLMV) or gross income exceeds approximately 3,000 SMLMV; mandatory also for S.A.S. entities expressly required by law, issuers of securities, entities under governmental supervision, or when the shareholders' meeting so orders.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia under Law 1314/2009 and Decreto 2420/2015: full IFRS for Grupo 1 entities; IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para las PYMES) for Grupo 2 entities typical of a small or medium S.A.S.; books and supporting documents must be retained for at least 7 years, with a 10-year preservation requirement under the Código de Comercio.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Per DIAN Resolution 164/2022 (RUBF), the S.A.S. must file and annually update direct and indirect Beneficiario Final data; any share transfer or change in ownership or control (generally 5% or more of capital or control) must be reported to the RUBF within 5 business days, and the share register must be concurrently annotated; the annual confirmation follows the DIAN calendar published each year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de la Asamblea de Accionistas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 120 - 350 per year (commercial address, mail handling and regulatory forwarding service in Bogotá or a provincial Chamber of Commerce jurisdiction)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - 3,500 for a small or medium S.A.S. below the compulsory Revisor Fiscal threshold; USD 4,000 - 9,000 when a full statutory audit is triggered
